mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a product of languages in contact."
Bilingualism is a product of languages in contact.

Nigeria is a multilingual country in which many indigenous languages exist and some foreign languages as well.

Individual bilingualism is a phenomenon in which an individual is capable of an alternative use of two languages.

Multilingualism is a phenomenon of linguistic pluralism within a single polity.

Coordinate bilingualism is a situation where a person is able to speak two different languages with equal or partially equal facility.

An official language is the language used by the government for the conduct of its day-to-day activities.

The English language is a second language in Nigeria because it is not our mother tongue or first language.
